exposure: preconception endocrine profiles (DHEAS, androstenedione, LH/FSH ratio)
cohort: The study included patients diagnosed with PCOS who had at least one successful delivery beyond the 23rd gestational week at the University of Debrecen between 2012 and 2019.
finding: PCOS patients who conceived with IVF exhibited different baseline hormone levels and experienced more adverse obstetric outcomes, including lower birth weight, lower gestational age, and higher rates of preterm delivery and cesarean section, compared to those who conceived without IVF.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly more frequent in the IVF group (71% vs. 43.2%) compared to the non-IVF group, a difference that persisted in singleton subgroups.
